description: This file defines the Subunit class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling report filtering on organizational subunits. It implements functionality to add filtering conditions to query builders based on selected subunits, convert subunit IDs to detailed representations, and modify subunit filter values.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: A class representing a filter field for organizational subunits within report generation, allowing filtering based on subunit hierarchy and IDs.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds filtering conditions to the query builder based on the selected subunit IDs and operator.

methods.name: getSubunitIds
methods.description: Retrieves an array of subunit IDs from the internal 'X' value, splitting comma-separated IDs.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the aliases used for entities in queries, here returning ['employee'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the stored subunit ID(s) into a descriptive array including ID and label, using the company structure service.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: Modifies the 'X' value by converting it into a chain of subunit IDs.
